title: Banned acts in a forest reserve
rule: In a national or local authority forest reserve, none of these acts may be done without a concession, licence or permit. People exercising a determined existing right are excepted.
points: Cutting, felling, digging up or removing any tree.
Removing protected plants or other forest produce.
Taking rock, stones, sand, shells or soil.
Opening saw-pits, building structures, roads, paths or bridges.
Carrying traps, nets, guns, poison or explosives.
Any other act banned by regulations, reserve rules or by-laws.
